UPDATE alert_rules SET
                name               = ?,
                description        = ?,
                enabled            = ?,
                expression         = ?,
                severity           = ?,
                for_duration_secs  = ?,
                eval_interval_secs = ?,
                cooldown_secs      = ?,
                silenced_until     = ?,
                updated_at         = unixepoch()
              WHERE id = ?
